persona: Simulated music fan new to production who wants a short dance groove

outcome.status: Mouse-only composition, naming and project save completed. UI confirmed WAV and MIDI exports. Playback could not be sustained because of repeated plug-in/render failures; independent artifact verification remains necessary.
outcome.composition: Four-bar MIDI phrase drawn with the mouse, using repeated C4 notes, D#4, G4 and a lower A#3 variation; duplicated alongside the supplied Circuit drums audio, with the last pair trimmed to bar 15. Rill Lab Sine assigned as VST3 instrument.
outcome.playback: Two playback attempts produced plug-in/render failures; retry briefly advanced the playhead then stopped. No audible-quality assessment.
outcome.wav_ui_confirmation: Exported NEON PULSE.wav visible in 33-wav-finish-check.png and final.png

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: I could construct, repeat, trim, name and save a 30-second arrangement using visible mouse controls, but note-editor discovery and playback failure interrupted the flow.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: The dark layout, teal waveforms and large note grid look cohesive and the arrangement remains readable.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Most editing actions responded promptly in this lab. WAV export displayed elapsed time and took long enough that I started another operation while waiting; playback failed twice. This is a perceived session rating, not a physical-device benchmark.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Right-click Edit notes worked after a double-click appeared to do nothing. The render-error Details repeated the retry advice without an actionable plug-in diagnosis. MIDI export replaced the WAV status, leaving me unsure whether WAV had completed.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: The visible toolset covered audio, VST3 MIDI, scale guidance, duplication, trimming, naming, save and both export formats. Successful reliable playback was not achieved in this session; other features and plug-ins were not evaluated.

findings.observation: Double-clicking the new MIDI clip did not visibly open the note editor; right-click > Edit notes did.
findings.recommendation: Make the clip-opening gesture dependable and show a direct Edit notes affordance on a selected MIDI clip.

findings.observation: Playback first reported hundreds of plug-in/render failures; Details showed 2651 failures. Stop/restart briefly moved the playhead and then stopped with 3 failures.
findings.recommendation: Provide a concrete failure reason and affected device in Details, and a recovery action that can be confirmed to work. Investigate this native lab VST path without generalizing to other plug-ins.

findings.observation: A MIDI clip automatically extended as notes were added, but ended at the last short note rather than the next bar. Extending the final note to bar 5 made duplication align with the four-bar audio.
findings.recommendation: Offer an obvious round-clip-length-to-bar action or visible end handle in the note editor for beginner loop construction.

findings.observation: Trimming an audio edge affected only that clip although its paired MIDI clip was also selected. A second edge drag was needed to reach 30 seconds in both lanes.
findings.recommendation: Clarify whether a trim applies to one clip or the selected group; consider a group-trim option.

findings.observation: Starting MIDI export replaced the prior WAV progress status. I repeated the WAV export to obtain an unambiguous completion result.
findings.recommendation: Keep separate export-job status or a completed-export history so overlapping operations cannot hide completion.

findings.observation: The rename keyboard Shift control stayed enabled, making the intended Neon pulse appear as NEON PULSE. The resulting title was acceptable.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish one-shot Shift from persistent Caps Lock, or clearly show the persistent state.

positives: The empty-lane Double-click for MIDI hint led directly to a usable instrument chooser.
Pencil, note-length choices, note labels and out-of-scale coloring made visual note entry understandable.
Marquee selection and Duplicate repeated audio and MIDI together.
The ruler shows seconds as well as bars, making the 30-second target easy to locate.
The built-in naming keyboard and title-based default filenames enabled genuinely mouse-only naming and saving.
File menu labels clearly expose both WAV and MIDI exports; WAV dialog states duration and allows effect tails to be excluded.
limitations: This is an independent simulated beginner session, not a real human study.
All app input used the supplied mouse driver. No keyboard events, source inspection, project injection or project-content inspection were used.
The supplied audio loop and actual native Rill Lab Sine VST3 were the only musical sources used; no inference about other third-party plug-ins.
Software graphics, no window manager and timer-paced virtual audio with documented 60 ms buffer and 1024-frame/48 kHz request can affect observed behavior.
No audio capture was auditioned. Sound quality, musical success by ear and hardware latency are not assessed.
Artifact contents, final PCM duration and MIDI validity are for coordinator verification.
